description: This file defines the ChainCache class, which implements caching by chaining multiple cache adapters together. It provides methods to generate cache keys, write to caches, load from caches, get timestamps, and remove cache entries across multiple cache implementations.

classes.name: ChainCache
classes.description: Implements a cache that chains multiple cache adapters, fetching data from the first cache that contains the item and updating all caches on write and delete operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ChainCache with an iterable list of cache objects.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key based on a name and class name.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes content to all caches under the generated key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Attempts to load a cache entry from the chain; stops if the class exists.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the latest timestamp from caches for a given key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from all caches that support removal.

methods.name: splitKey
methods.description: Splits a cache key into its components (name and class name).
